blocks.text: The queue for the Louvre wrapped almost all the way around the courtyard, but it moved faster than I expected once I got close to I. M. Pei's glass pyramid, which looks almost weightless against the old stone facade behind it.
Inside, the sheer scale of the former royal palace is dizzying - room after room of gilded ceilings, and somewhere among the crowds, the Mona Lisa, smaller and quieter than I imagined.
